# EGit feature

Packaging: `eclipse-feature`. The optional Git integration groups EGit core and UI bundles and requires the base eReviewBoard and EGit features. Its [feature descriptor](../../org.review_board.ereviewboard.egit/feature.xml) defines actual included plug-ins and version constraints; [the update site](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.update/overview.md) catalogs the feature. This module has no runtime Java code.

See [EGit core](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.egit.core/overview.md) for base revisions and [EGit UI](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.egit.ui/overview.md) for registration.
